label: Candidates in, survivors out
subgoals: Remove candidates that exclude an initial state or a successor of the intersection
Count the candidates that survive the round

label: Iterating to the fixpoint
subgoals: Recompute the intersection after each round's removals
Remove the candidates that the larger intersection now breaks
Stop when a round removes nothing and count the survivors

label: Rounds, cost and trust
subgoals: Count one query per surviving candidate per round
Count the rounds, including the final round that removes nothing
Feed counterexamples to induction back to the proposer
